key_insight: The stabilizer norm alone cannot determine robustness in Pauli-limited quantum certification: physical channel constraints make the target’s operator structure matter.
engineering_relevance: Dual certificates quantify how measurement uncertainty affects fidelity bounds and guide shot allocation under a fixed measurement budget.
method: Characterize the positivity-free relaxation exactly using the target Choi state’s stabilizer norm.
Derive a necessary and sufficient KKT tightness condition and dual certificates for strict physicality gaps.
Derive exact shot-allocation rules for fixed certificates, including compatible observables sharing measurement settings.
evidence_signal: A rigorous computer-assisted proof establishes two distinct two-qubit targets with exactly equal stabilizer norm but different physical robustness.
watch_item: Whether every full-support two-qubit target has positive gain from enforcing physicality remains open.
paper_title: Beyond the Stabilizer Norm: Physicality and Resource Allocation in Pauli-Limited Quantum Certification
